title: How am I

start.heading: Weekly check-in
start.intro: Eight short questions about how you have felt. Answers are private. This is not a diagnosis.

questions.missing: This question is not available in this version of the app.

phq4.q1: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
phq4.q3: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
phq4.q4: Not being able to stop or control worrying

pss4.q1: In the last month, how often have you felt that you were unable to control the important things in your life?
pss4.q2: In the last month, how often have you felt confident about your ability to handle your personal problems?
pss4.q3: In the last month, how often have you felt that things were going your way?
pss4.q4: In the last month, how often have you felt difficulties were piling up so high that you could not overcome them?

feedback.none: Thank you for checking in. Take a moment for yourself when you can.
feedback.elevated: Thank you for sharing. It may help to talk with a psychologist.
feedback.crisis: Thank you for telling us. Please use the numbers below or contact a person on duty.

suggestion.heading: A suggestion for you
suggestion.practice: Try a short audio practice when you have a quiet minute.
suggestion.tea: Meet a mother nearby for tea when you are ready.
suggestion.talk: Open Talk to write freely to the assistant.
suggestion.psychologist: A psychologist on duty can contact you.

elevated.heading: Talk to a psychologist
elevated.description: A person on duty will contact you as soon as possible.
elevated.sent: Request sent. A person on duty will contact you.
elevated.queued: No connection. Your request is saved and will be sent automatically when you are back online.
elevated.failed: The request could not be sent. Try again or open Help for phone numbers.

history.title: Past check-ins
